newsitem.title: UK: Japan Development Bank eyes $500 mln bond -dealers.
newsitem.headline: Japan Development Bank eyes $500 mln bond -dealers.

text.p: The Japan Development Bank (JDB) may launch a $500 million five-year bond next week, syndicate managers said on Thursday.

"JDB is planning a $500 million five-year deal, and the issue is likely to be jointly underwritten by a European and a U.S. bank," a syndicate head said, adding no specific mandate had yet been awarded.
The timing of the issue, guaranteed by Japan, would depend on how the U.S. Treasury market reacts to U.S. retail sales and producer price data due for release on Friday.
"If PPI data is good for the market, the deal will be launched on Monday, otherwise they will wait until after the release of consumer price data next Tuesday," a dealer at a U.S. bank said.
Markets remain edgy about the prospects for U.S. inflation and interest rates, and the data will be closely watched.
Other Japanese credits said to be eyeing the dollar bond market include Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, bankers said.
